chat.settings.help.always_show_sidebar_o: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop, rather than having it automatically hide.
chat.settings.help.api_key: If you’re using the `--api-key` option when configuring the server, make sure you set the API key.
chat.settings.help.ask_for_title_confirm: Before automatically changing the conversation title while editing the first message, always ask for confirmation first.
chat.settings.help.auto_show_sidebar_on_: Automatically display the sidebar when you start a new chat. To keep the sidebar hidden until you click on it, uncheck this option.
chat.settings.help.backend_sampling: Activate server-side sampling. When activated, supported sampling methods will run on the accelerator for faster processing.
chat.settings.help.copy_text_attachments: When copying a message that includes text attachments, combine them into a single, unformatted text string rather than using a special format that would allow them to be pasted back in as separate attachments
chat.settings.help.custom_json: Custom JSON parameters to send to the API. Must be in valid JSON format.
chat.settings.help.disable_auto_scroll: Disable automatic scrolling as new messages appear, allowing you to manually control where the screen focuses.
chat.settings.help.disable_reasoning_par: Send reasoning_format=none to prevent server-side extraction of reasoning tokens into separate field.
chat.settings.help.dry_allowed_length: Using ‘DRY sampling’ helps to minimise repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy input. This parameter determines the maximum length permitted when using ‘DRY sampling’.
chat.settings.help.dry_base: Using ‘DRY’ sampling minimises repetition in generated text, even with lengthy input. This setting adjusts the base value for ‘DRY’ sampling.
chat.settings.help.dry_multiplier: Using ‘DRY’ sampling minimises repetition in generated text, even with lengthy input. This parameter controls the ‘DRY’ sampling strength.
chat.settings.help.dry_penalty_last_n: Using a ‘DRY’ sampling method reduces repetition in generated text, even when dealing with lengthy input. This setting controls the ‘DRY’ penalty applied to the final ‘n’ tokens.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_e: Add-on for the temperature sampler. Refines the probability redistribution by prioritising the most likely token.
chat.settings.help.dynamic_temperature_r: Add-on for the temperature sampler. It enhances the range of dynamic temperatures by adjusting probabilities based on the entropy of the tokens.
chat.settings.help.enable_continue_gener: Enable the “Continue” button for messages from the assistant. Currently, this feature only works with models that don’t use reasoning capabilities.
chat.settings.help.endpoint: Choose Open-ended Responses (recommended) or Chat Completions (legacy)
chat.settings.help.frequency_penalty: Limits the number of tokens based on their frequency in the generated text.
chat.settings.help.keep_stats_visible: Keep the processing statistics displayed once the generation is complete.
chat.settings.help.max_tokens: The maximum number of tokens in the output. Use -1 to indicate unlimited (no limit).
chat.settings.help.min_p: Limits tokens based on the lowest probability a token needs to have, compared to the probability of the most likely token, to be included.
chat.settings.help.parse_pdf_as_image: Render PDF as an image rather than text. Automatically reverts to text-based processing for models that don’t support image input.
chat.settings.help.paste_long_text_to_fi: When you paste a large amount of text, it will be saved as a file. You can adjust the maximum file size by changing the value of this setting. A value of 0 disables this feature.
chat.settings.help.presence_penalty: Limits the number of tokens, depending on whether they’re present in the generated text or not.
chat.settings.help.py_interpreter_enable: Enable the Python interpreter using Pyodide. This allows you to run Python code within markdown code blocks.
chat.settings.help.render_user_content_a: Format user messages in the chat using Markdown.
chat.settings.help.repeat_last_n: The number of previous tokens to take into account when discouraging repetition
chat.settings.help.repeat_penalty: Manages the repetition of word sequences in the generated text
chat.settings.help.samplers: The order in which sampling methods are applied, in a simplified manner. The default is “top_k;typical_p;top_p;minimum_p;temperature”: top_k → typical_p → top_p → minimum_p → temperature
chat.settings.help.show_message_stats: Show display statistics (tokens per second, total tokens, and duration) underneath each message from the assistant.
chat.settings.help.show_microphone_on_em: For models that support audio input, automatically display the microphone button instead of the send button when the text input field is empty.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_llm_output: Display the unprocessed output from the large language model, without any backend processing or frontend formatting, to enable inspection of the streaming functionality across various models.
chat.settings.help.show_raw_output_switc: Show a per-message toggle to display plain raw model output instead of Markdown rendering.
chat.settings.help.show_system_message: Show the system message at the top of each chat.
chat.settings.help.show_thought_in_progr: By default, elaborate on your thinking when creating responses.
chat.settings.help.show_tool_calls: Display tool call labels and payloads from any Harmony-compatible `delta.tool_calls` data appearing after the assistant’s messages.
chat.settings.help.system_message: The initial prompt that sets out how the model should operate.
chat.settings.help.temperature: Controls how varied the generated text is by influencing the likelihood of different words appearing in the output. A higher value means more unpredictable results, while a lower value produces more consistent and predictable text.
chat.settings.help.theme: Select the colour scheme for the interface. You can choose between System (which uses your device’s settings), Light, or Dark.
chat.settings.help.top_k: Retain only the top *k* most frequent tokens.
chat.settings.help.top_p: Limit the tokens to those whose combined probability totals at least *p*
chat.settings.help.typical_p: Categorises and restricts tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
chat.settings.help.xtc_probability: The XTC sampler removes the most frequent words; this setting determines the probability of any word being removed. Setting it to 0 disables XTC.
chat.settings.help.xtc_threshold: The XTC sampler removes the most frequent tokens; this parameter controls the probability threshold for a token to be removed.
